headline: Rolling Stones Take the Stage for the First Time at London's Marquee Club
dispatch: An unknown five-piece band calling themselves the Rolling Stones performed their first concert Thursday night at the Marquee Club on Oxford Street in London. The group, led by vocalist Mick Jagger and guitarist Brian Jones, played a set of American rhythm and blues covers before a small but enthusiastic crowd. Club regulars took notice of the raw energy on display, with several patrons predicting a future for the young act.
answer: The Rolling Stones play their debut concert, 1962
